[[EStar (Chinese Team)|EStar]] for it. === Statistics === * Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on June 13, 2023. ** The 41st player and 7th jungler (after [[Clearlove]], [[SofM]], [[Karsa]], [[Tian]],
